initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is -0.4, but the numerical checks do not establish causal identification. Request archived design record R290-2 to assess whether the average causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: Lottery assignment independent of both potential outcomes, full compliance, positivity, consistency, and no interference identify the causal risk difference. The exact population risks are 1/10 under X=1 and 20/40 under X=0, yielding 0.1 − 0.5 = −0.4.
